ValidationRule.description:
Date Sent to Ops' to be required if 'Acepted Rejected' field has a value
Edit:Case11637971 - Date Sent to Ops required only if 'Accepted Rejected' field value is 'Rejected'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name = "CLAS – Data Management", NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT( Accepted_Rejected__c ))), TEXT( Accepted_Rejected__c ) = 'Rejected', ISBLANK( Date_Sent_to_Ops__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 'Date Sent to Ops' must have a value if 'Acepted Rejected' is 'Rejected'
